tools.name: get_metrics_definition
tools.description: Returns the official CDT Express definitions for metrics: dcr_score, expected_impact, cvar_50, cvar_95, cvar_99, var_50, var_95, var_99.

tools.name: get_climate_metrics_exposure
tools.description: Returns raw meteorological hazard statistics (e.g., days of extreme heat, flood depth). Use this when asked about weather, temperature, or physical phenomena.

tools.name: get_climate_metrics_impact
